title: Ready, episode 2: screens before everything
worry: Screens before jobs, outside and everything else
needs: NEW: the girl, about seven, tapping a job done on a tablet then running outside to play
NEW: the girl, about eleven, comes in from the garden muddy and happy, then picks up the tablet

beats.line: Every day starts with a screen.

beats.me: She wants screens before anything else. How do I change that?
digi: Make the job the way in, not the punishment.
Flag one job before screens, and let the app say it.

beats.line: One job first. The app says it, not you.
She ticks it. You approve. Stars land.
One star is worth five minutes.
Jobs first is just how the day goes.
